description:
Convierte documentos de ejemplo (p. ej. respuestas de una API) en un JSON Schema inicial: une los tipos vistos en cada ruta, marca como requeridas las claves presentes en todos y describe los ítems. Cuándo: hay que transformar, comparar o revisar con exactitud datos estructurados (JSON, CSV, YAML, XML, arreglos). No para: validar un JSON contra un JSON Schema (json-schema-validate). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Turns sample documents (for example API replies) into a starter JSON Schema: merges the types seen at each path, marks keys present in every sample as required and describes array items. When: structured data (JSON, CSV, YAML, XML, arrays) has to be transformed, compared or checked exactly. [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Turns sample documents (for example API replies) into a starter JSON Schema: merges the types seen at each path, marks keys present in every sample as required and describes array items. When: structured data (JSON, CSV, YAML, XML, arrays) has to be transformed, compared or checked exactly. Not for: validating a JSON value against a JSON Schema using a built-in subset (json-schema-validate). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

samples.description: Sample values (same shape expected) (array; required; at least 1 items; up to 1000 items).

name: json-schema-from-samples
title: Inferir JSON Schema de ejemplos
